# Fixtures for `ttf` (TrueType font)

Fonts made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for a fictitious type foundry (Saltmere Harbour Type) with fixed timestamps; outlines are plain boxes. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/fonts.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `saltmere-flags-colr.ttf` | fontTools 4.60.1 FontBuilder (static, variable with fvar / gvar / STAT, COLRv0 / CPAL) | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-flex-variable.ttf` | fontTools 4.60.1 FontBuilder (static, variable with fvar / gvar / STAT, COLRv0 / CPAL) | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-sans.ttf` | fontTools 4.60.1 FontBuilder (static, variable with fvar / gvar / STAT, COLRv0 / CPAL) | CC0-1.0 |
